**On-call handoff — gateway 503s, 2026-03-14**

**Root cause:** Deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, gateway, 02:12–02:14Z) flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. Right after, the connection pool maxed out at 20/20 in use and stayed there. Every error is `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, and the wait queue climbs the whole time (13 → 74+), so it never recovers on its own.

**Impact window:** Started 2026-03-14T02:14:18Z. Still failing at the end of the log, 2026-03-14T03:59:27Z, so it was ongoing when the log cuts off.

**Roll back:** `dep-4471` on gateway. Other deploys that night (`dep-4468` catalog, `dep-4469` accounts, `dep-4470` worker, `dep-4472` billing, `dep-4473` catalog) are all clean, no need to touch them.

**Scope:** Gateway only. `worker.log` shows no errors or pool issues in this window, just one unrelated known slow-query warning at 02:36 (OPS-2210).
